components.provenance: Read-only observer over the convergence-owned Living bounded survey. It reflects bounded progress and availability without owning search state, invoking searchWorlds or enterKey, exposing canonical keys, enumerating the universe, or creating a second discovery UI.

Non-owning Living accessibility and direct-manipulation observer. Native pointer, drag, pinch, wheel, keyboard and click selection remain convergence-owned; this lane observes bounded central input state, publishes reversible presentation-only metadata, and never calls travel, renderer-input or selection APIs. Unknown stage remains unknown; the canonical viewport label and aria-pressed state are preserved. Reversible aria-current is added only when no other owner supplies it and yields permanently to external ownership. Skip routing, focus continuity, transition announcements, bounded survey UI and context docking remain convergence-owned Living capabilities rather than duplicated lane UI.

Lane styling is gated by V2X-14 presentation markers. It hardens the real Living canvas with touch-action and overscroll containment, focus-visible and reduced-motion behavior, and keeps optional systemic-audio controls at 44px desktop / 48px coarse-pointer targets with portrait, landscape, forced-colors and safe-area handling. It does not create or style duplicate Living skip, context, survey, focus or announcement surfaces.
